phrase.zh: 磁场留下看不见的节奏。
phrase.en: A magnetic rhythm shapes the Sun.

visual.zh: 发亮的太阳边缘伸出成束弧线，表现磁场与太阳物质的互动。弧线是视觉转译，不是某一天的磁场实测图。
visual.en: Bright arcs rise from the solar rim to suggest the interplay of magnetic fields and solar material. Their paths are visual interpretation, not a measured field map from a particular day.

background.zh: 太阳活动约每 11 年经历一个周期，太阳黑子、耀斑与日冕物质抛射的活跃程度随之变化。NASA 与 NOAA 说明，这个周期由太阳磁场的变化驱动；图像不能用于预测空间天气。
background.en: Solar activity follows an approximately 11-year cycle, with changing levels of sunspots, flares and coronal mass ejections. NASA and NOAA link the cycle to changes in the Sun’s magnetic field; this picture cannot forecast space weather.
